items.summary: Reject new proposals, queue actions, production changes, monetization expansion, and unsupported financial or causal-lift claims this cycle. Preserve only existing bounded, reversible work with its current owners and measurement gates. Amazon reports $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission for 2026-09-21; site revenue, margin, ROI, CAC, payback, profitability, forecasts, and cost-to-learn remain unsupported. Keep SearchWoot private pending owner direction and unresolved rights, legal, security, accuracy, privacy, attribution, and measurement gates.

Owner decision required: choose one option for SearchWoot—authorize preparation of an unsent provider-permission request, keep private with no outreach, or end the public-beta pursuit. No outreach, credential or configuration change, spending, schedule change, telemetry change, launch, or production work is authorized.

Recommendation: route only the three existing bounded workstreams below to engineer under their current owners and measurement gates. Reject all new monetization, unsupported financial claims, high-priority queue work, telemetry duplication, production expansion, spending, credential changes, and SearchWoot launch activity. Accept work only after isolated execution, quality and smoke checks, explicit rollback notes, and measurement at 14 days or 100 new impressions. No revenue, ROI, margin, CAC, payback, profitability, forecast, or causal-lift claims are supported.
